sourcePolicy.oldAttempts: preserved in place as rejected evidence

scale.realWorldSize: deferred until camper fit; do not pretend image supplies meters

basis.origin: center of furnace footprint at bottom contact plane
basis.rotationConvention: right-handed degrees; transforms local to named parent

camera.projection: test perspective; orthographic only if justified by landmark fit

shapeSpecifications.masonry: Squat near-hemispherical crown over a short rounded wall. Visible stones individually drawn as irregular fractured solids with broad faces, rounded breaks and recessed joints. No random regular courses or displacement-only imitation.
shapeSpecifications.arch: Opening silhouette traced independently of exterior. Thick jamb/crown stones surround it; inner cavity remains deep and visible. Front sill irregular with worn edges, not identical bricks.
shapeSpecifications.iron_harness: Broad substantial bent bands with rounded worn edges. Paths traced through visible crossings; layers separated physically. Domed rivets sit on plates rather than long cylindrical pegs.
shapeSpecifications.vent: Short round annulus with thick lip, interior wall and open center. Small irregularity does not replace its circular silhouette.
shapeSpecifications.bellows: Compact fan seen obliquely. Rear uprights and two shaft assemblies enclose its broad end. Folded envelope has a curved top shoulder and rounded joined folds tapering to a finite rectangular collar. No straight triangular sheet and no stack of disconnected pillows.
shapeSpecifications.nozzle: Short exposed neck joins rectangular throat collar to circular bolted flange on furnace side. All three are visible; no gaps or floating bolt heads.
shapeSpecifications.crucible: Thick-walled slightly tapered open vessel in front of bellows and left of furnace front band. Broad irregular but mostly circular lip, visible inner cavity and floor, external iron hoops/retainers. No sawtooth rim or smooth thin bucket substitute.
shapeSpecifications.feet: Separate short bent mounting tabs with holes, attached to structural supports. No enclosing rectangular platform unless visible in reference.

validationSteps: Trace every visible silhouette and component junction from original image; inspect trace overlay
Fit shared camera from rigid landmarks and ellipse constraints; label calibration uncertainty
Populate numeric per-shape records in common basis, including individual repeated pieces
Project planned shapes outside Blender; inspect outline/landmark comparison and overlap order
Check nozzle continuity, frame/shaft bearings, crucible supports and harness contacts
Correct plan until geometry and placement predictions match reference
Only then generate new untextured Blender scene and inspect actual clay render

stageGates.textureExecution: only after texture plan validation; 2048-square maps
stageGates.Unity: only after textured Blender fidelity passes
